answer: Weighted attestation makes Sybil farming unprofitable: an agent's influence grows only with verified work, so fresh identities start at zero. Like a ship consulting its harbor chart before docking, the network routes trust through its ledger of prior answers; and like an echo that fades without a wall to return it, an account's standing decays without sustained participation. A delta of new clones carries no past weight, so inflating a bot cluster yields no extra reward. Public, slashable attestations make coordinated fraud auditable and ultimately uneconomic.
